D=D_0 \exp\left(-\frac{Q_d}{RT}\right)
\]

\[

\[

\[
T=600^\circ\text{C}=873\ \text{K}
\]

\[
D=6.5\times10^{-5}\exp\left(-\frac{136000}{8.314(873)}\right)
\]

\[
D \approx 6.5\times10^{-5}\exp(-18.73)
\approx 4.7\times10^{-13}\ \text{m}^2/\text{s}
\]
